one_line: Demonstrates how chin projection alters the perceived size of the nose using a split-screen comparison and an interactive physical test.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen slider compares a woman's face before and after, asking if her nose is too big.
hook.why_it_works: It challenges the viewer's visual perception immediately.

shots.description: Split-screen slider showing 'Before' and 'After' of a woman's face, highlighting the chin change.
Heatmap visualization showing pixel changes concentrated on the jawline.
shots.layout: darkened portrait with glowing pixel overlay and bar chart

shots.description: Annotated close-up explaining the relationship between chin projection and nose perception.
shots.layout: portrait with circular annotations and labels

shots.description: Interactive text prompt instructing the viewer to push their lower jaw forward.
shots.layout: minimalist text list on solid background

shots.description: Side-by-side comparison of the original and edited face.
Search bar animation prompting the user to search for Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Introduce the optical illusion of nose size vs. chin projection.
Prove the illusion using pixel-change data.
Explain the cognitive science of facial feature comparison.
Engage the viewer with a physical, real-time test.
Pitch the AI tool as a way to preview these changes on oneself.

cta.what: Search 'Refina AI' to preview facial changes on your own face.

subjects: An unidentified woman acting as the visual model for facial structure changes.
what_makes_it_work: The interactive 'try it now' segment forces physical engagement, proving the concept instantly.
Data-driven visualization (pixel heatmap) builds scientific credibility.

animations.purpose: Demonstrates subtle differences between before and after states.
animations.reusable_as: Before/after comparisons for editing, beauty, or restoration services.

animations.name: Feature Callout Circles
animations.what_moves: Oval outlines around the chin and nose
animations.purpose: Directs viewer attention to specific facial features being discussed.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting key areas of interest on products or diagrams.

animations.purpose: Quantifies and proves where edits were actually made.

animations.name: Interactive Step List
animations.purpose: Guides user through a physical test to experience the illusion.

animations.name: Portrait Split Comparison
animations.what_moves: Single portrait splitting into two side-by-side panels
animations.purpose: Transitions from a split-screen slider to a full side-by-side comparison.

animations.reusable_as: Search bar mockups or URL typing simulations.
